title: Blood Red Sunday
excerpt: A human doctor is summoned to save a patient whose heart stopped a century ago.

sections.title: The Patient
paragraphs: Dr. Lena Ortiz knew the patient was impossible before she touched him.
No pulse. No breathing. Eyes open and furious.
'You were recommended,' the woman beside the bed said. 'For discretion.'

sections.title: The Diagnosis
paragraphs: The illness was not death. It was something older, moving through blood that should not have moved at all.
Lena stayed because leaving would not make the impossible less real.
By morning, the patient knew her name and she knew his secret.

sections.title: Sunday
paragraphs: He laughed when she told him, then stopped when he realized she was serious.
At dawn on Sunday, they stood together behind a curtain and decided exactly how much light a second life was worth.
